scope: Completing the confirmed release implementation and validation
implementation_direction: Do not treat the previous testing dollar caps or cost optimization as a blocker to necessary release work.
preserved_requirements: Keep accurate request, reservation and charge records, including unknown charges.
Do not reset, reopen or falsely resume the original stopped smoke journal.
Preserve workload sizes, request ceilings, evidence integrity and readiness thresholds.
Use isolated staging resources and do not mutate production sessions or accounting.
Production launch still requires passing readiness and content-bound owner approval.
